_comment: Hand-written news for the in-app notification inbox. Add an item with a unique id; the App feed workflow publishes it to the 'feed' branch. link: an https URL or one of update, extensions, market, streams, support.

items.body: New episodes, extensions, stream playlists and Yumeiro news now land here. Choose what you hear about in Settings > Notifications.
